about.metaDescription: Neem Woods — specialist suppliers of sawn African tropical hardwoods from the forests of Gabon. 13 species online, 27 on the way. Inquire on WhatsApp.
about.heading: Who We Are
about.heroLead: Specialist suppliers of African tropical hardwoods — from the forests of Gabon to projects worldwide.
about.intro: Neem Woods is a specialist supplier of sawn African tropical hardwoods, operating from the heart of the forests of the Republic of Gabon — one of the richest and most diverse tropical forest environments on Earth.
about.experience: Run by a team with over 25 years in the timber trade, Neem Woods has built its reputation on two things: deep product knowledge and product quality. We do more than sell timber — we understand every species from the tree to the finished piece, guiding each client toward the right choice for their project.
about.quote: Fine hardwood isn't just a building material — it's an investment that lasts decades.
about.distinctionBody1: We make it our job to build real awareness of African wood species, their properties, and where each one performs best — because an informed buyer makes the right call.
about.distinctionBody2: Right now we list 13 of Gabon's finest woods on our site, each with full specs so engineers, designers, and contractors anywhere in the world can choose with confidence.
about.visionBody: Our catalog doesn't stop here. An expanded 27-species catalog is on the way, including exceptionally rare species that are hard to find outside the forests of Gabon. Our goal is for Neem Woods to become the first name in African tropical hardwoods — knowledge, product, and expertise in one place.
about.tagline: Neem Woods — from the forests of Gabon to your projects.
